description: Amplitude is a digital analytics platform that helps companies improve customer experiences by providing insights into user actions across websites, mobile applications, and other digital products.
BambooHR is a cloud-based human resources (HR) software that powers the strategic evolution of HR in small and medium-sized businesses.
Bridgecrew is a cybersecurity company that develops and delivers security as code so enterprises can deploy the defenses needed to protect their cloud infrastructure.
Cloudsmith is a cloud-native, global, universal software artifact management platform for enterprises to develop and distribute software securely.

Couchbase is a distributed NoSQL cloud database that delivers versatility, performance, scalability, and financial value to cloud, mobile, on-premises, hybrid, distributed cloud, and edge computing applications.
Fastly is a cloud computing company that provides a content delivery network, offering businesses control over performance analytics in real-time.
Harness is an intelligent software delivery platform that enables engineers to deliver software faster, with higher quality and less effort.
LiveView Technologies is a remote camera and data acquisition solution for companies to keep their properties protected and their employees and customers safe.

Oyster is a global employment platform that empowers companies to hire, pay, and care for their global teams. Oyster’s technology enables people-centric hiring anywhere in the world with reliable, compliant contracts, payroll, and great local benefits and perks.
Socure is a digital identity verification and trust platform that uses AI and machine learning to reduce fraud.

Talon (now Palo Alto Network’s Prisma Browser) is a cybersecurity company that transforms internet browsers into secure distributed workspaces with the market’s most complete enterprise browser security solutions. Enterprises benefit from Talon’s visibility and control over all SaaS and web applications, enabling them to secure any user, on any device, from any location.

Uniphore is a Business AI company that connects enterprise data, fine-tunes AI models and deploys agentic AI across the enterprise. Uniphore bridges the gap between consumer and enterprise AI, delivering the simplicity, personalization, and ease of use that business users expect, with the enterprise-grade security, governance, and scalability that IT demands.
